attempts.errorSummary:
3 test-code bugs found after fixing server crash (dev server restarted successfully — 7/10 tests now pass). The 3 remaining failures are all in e2e/plp-quick-view.spec.ts:

Bug 1 (E2E-002 line ~133, E2E-003 line ~133): BASELINE_NOISE_PATTERNS is missing patterns for pre-existing sandbox noise: (a) 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 403 (Forbidden)' — the browser's resource-failure message companion to the already-filtered 'r: 403 Forbidden'; (b) '400 Bad Request' errors from shopper-customers API (guest users hitting /customers/{id}/baskets and /product-lists get 400 in sandbox). Fix: add /Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 40[03]/ and /r: 400 Bad Request/ to BASELINE_NOISE_PATTERNS.

Bug 2 (E2E-008 line 405-406): Selector 'a img, a picture, a' inside '[data-testid^="sf-product-tile-"]' finds nothing because sf-product-tile-{id} IS on the <a> element itself (base ProductTile spreads {...rest} onto its root <Link>). Looking for 'a' inside 'a' matches nothing. Fix: use firstTile.locator('img').first().click() or firstTile.click() directly.

bugs_fixed.issue: Missing controlled variation management — modal used URL-based variation params instead of React state, causing variant resolution to fail and add-to-cart to silently no-op
bugs_fixed.fix: Added useControlledVariations hook and passed controlledVariationValues/onVariationChange to ProductView and useProductViewModal

bugs_fixed.issue: itemsAdded passed to AddToCartModal was flat {productId, quantity} — AddToCartModal expects {product, variant, quantity} with product.imageGroups
bugs_fixed.fix: Built separate productItems (for basket API) and itemsAdded (with full product/variant objects including imageGroups) for AddToCartModal
